ctx.title: Ajith Kumar starrer Dare Devil to feature Sreeleela? Adhik Ravichandran to begin filming on November 12
ctx.summary:
Ajith Kumar is set to begin filming his next project, Dare Devil, directed by Adhik Ravichandran. Marking the actor and filmmaker’s second collaboration, the upcoming film will feature Sreeleela in a key role, the director has confirmed. 
 Dare Devil: Adhik Ravichandran confirms Sreeleela cast in Ajith Kumar starrer 
 Speaking to Behindwoods TV, Adhik Ravichandran confirmed that Sreeleela will be part of  Dare Devil , alongside Parthiban, Prabhu, and Sunil. 
 “There has been a lot of discussion about the casting of Dare Devil. If talking about it, Sreeleela ma’am is part of the film, along with Parthiban sir, Prabhu, and Sunil, who are also acting alongside Ajith Kumar sir. There are a lot of surprises in the film,” the filmmaker said. 
 Adhik also revealed that Ajith Kumar came up with the film’s title, just as he did for their previous collaboration,  Good Bad Ugly . 
 “The title ‘Good Bad Ugly’ was given by Ajith sir, and this time, the title ‘Dare Devil’ was also given by him. Ajith sir wanted Prabhu sir in the film, and they have a very good bond,” he explained. 
 The director further stated that filming was planned around Chennai’s unpredictable weather conditions. As a result, the team decided to shoot the Indian portions in Hyderabad. 
 Adhik confirmed that filming would begin on November 12 at 8:05 AM, following Diwali. The production team is also planning to shoot in Thailand and Malaysia.
